unit.why: A short narrative about R. Menachem Nachum of Makarov: while ill and isolated, three close hasidim visit him, he says they revived him, then he dozes, dreams a Torah teaching and tells it to them.

stories.start_quote: מהרב הצדיק וכו׳ ר׳ מנחם נחום
stories.end_quote: לעבדו בכל לבבינו אמן זי״ע ועכי״א
stories.summary_en: The Makarover rebbe, sick and kept from visitors, is revived by three hasidim who come from afar, saying he is nothing without Jews; he then dozes, dreams a homily on 'their idols are silver and gold' (Ps. 115) about worry over money and lack of faith in providence, and tells it to them.
